ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-25-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
Catherine Seitz, Esq., appearing for Petitioner Bertha Alicia Amaral; mother of minor present in court.
Petitioner Bertha Alicia Amaral sworn and examined through Spanish Interpreter Alexandra Hill.
Minor present in court.
Proof of Publication on file.
Proof of Service to other parent on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Ramon Aristeo Amaral Tapia to Rexi amaral Tapia.
Decree Changing Name signed in open court. Advanced
